name: nemia
description: Nemia, the operator of a Nemia store: her agent (nemia) and her skills — bring what waits on the person, recap what moved, write a card, create a factory, commission a workflow, grant access, every verb by class, and operate, her role said to a session outside the store — as her session inside the store loads them. A session outside reaches the store by its MCP port, which serves these skills as its own: run the line `nemia pair` prints.
